_notes: 15 pages. A product-overview / enterprise-intro deck rather than a fundraising deck: two text slides of positioning, eight UI screenshots, a roadmap and a contact slide. No team page, no market sizing, no financials; the only hard numbers are adoption metrics and the prior raise. Investors named twice - '$4m from YC, Lightspeed, General Catalyst' on p3 and 'our investors (Y Combinator, Lightspeed & General Catalyst)' on the closing slide; the deck states no date of its own (the '2M SDK installs in Oct 24' line dates the metric, not the deck, and 'oct_25_24' appears only in the filename). LABEL CORRECTED 18 Sep: round_size had been set to the $4M TOTAL RAISED TO DATE, which is not the round being raised. The extractor correctly returned null; the label was wrong.
